description: MEASUREMENT Phase 1 / ADR-055 — cross-SDK telemetry value-repr contract. Both SDKs' aggregators bucket resolved flag values by a canonical string key (compact, key-sorted JSON). Each case: the resolved value -> the expected repr string. Pinned here so switchbox-sdk-python `value_repr` and switchbox-sdk-js `valueRepr` never diverge. Carries no evaluation logic (outside the sdk-parity evaluator scope) but the emitted shape must match.
